# go.gala.fyi/stdlib

The [GALA](https://github.com/martianoff/gala) standard library as a plain Go
module, for Go programs that use GALA-generated code.

```sh
go get go.gala.fyi/stdlib@latest
```

Every GALA release publishes a version here with the same number (GALA
`0.87.0` is `v0.87.0`). Use the version that matches the compiler your GALA
code was generated with.

**Do not edit this repository.** Its contents are generated by GALA's release
pipeline from the compiler's sources; changes belong in
[martianoff/gala](https://github.com/martianoff/gala). The `VERSION` file names
the GALA release and commit each version was exported from.
